author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 13; ensure at least four current turns classified as product_technical across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer bought a smart thermostat and is having trouble with the app connection.

messages.content: My thermostat shows offline in the app even though the Wi-Fi is fine.
Sorry about that. Could you confirm the thermostat is within 30 feet of your router?
It's about 15 feet away, in the same room actually.
Thanks. Try power-cycling the thermostat and then re-pairing it through the app's device menu.

variants.text: I did that and it still won't connect. Is there a firmware update I should install first?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, forget the troubleshooting — I'd rather return this and get the older model instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Okay I'll try that later. By the way, do you sell replacement faceplates for this model?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but the package was left at the wrong building.

messages.content: My lamp was marked delivered but I never got it.
Let me check the delivery photo. One moment.
Sure, take your time.
The photo shows a porch with a blue door, but your building has a gray entrance. It looks misdelivered.

variants.text: Can you send a replacement to my office address instead? I'll be there all week.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Oh well, just refund me then. I don't want to deal with this anymore.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks for checking. Could you also tell me if this lamp works with dimmer switches?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a coffee grinder they received as a gift.

messages.content: I got a burr grinder as a gift but there's no manual inside the box.
I can email you a PDF manual. Could you share the model number on the bottom plate?
It says CG-210. Also, is this the one with the stainless steel burrs?
Yes, CG-210 has stainless conical burrs. I've sent the manual to your email on file.

variants.text: Got the manual, thanks. One more thing — what grind setting works best for pour-over?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I realize I'd rather exchange this for the smaller hand-grinder model. Is that possible?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Perfect, that's all I needed. Have a great day!
variants.label: general

families.scenario: Customer's account was locked after too many login attempts.

messages.content: I can't log in, it says my account is locked.
That happens after several failed attempts. I can unlock it once you verify your identity.
Okay, what do you need from me?
Please confirm the email address and the last four digits of the card on file.

variants.text: The email is j.martinez@mail.com and the card ends in 4821.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Hmm, actually this isn't urgent anymore — I'll just reset the password later myself.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Wait, before that — can I speak to a real person? I've been going back and forth too long.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer bought running shoes that arrived with a stitching defect.

messages.content: My new running shoes have loose stitching near the toe on the left shoe.
I'm sorry to see that. Would you like a replacement pair or a refund?
I'd prefer a replacement if possible.
Sure, I can arrange that. The replacement will ship once the return is scanned.

variants.text: Great, I'll drop the return off tomorrow. Also, do these shoes run narrow or true to size?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just refund me — I found the same pair cheaper elsewhere.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Perfect, thanks for handling this so quickly.
variants.label: general

families.scenario: Customer is tracking a delayed shipment of a birthday gift.

messages.content: My order from last week still says 'processing' and the birthday is in three days.
Let me look into that order for you. Can you confirm the order number?
It's order #88421. I really need it by Friday.
I see it's held at the warehouse due to a stock discrepancy. I'll escalate it to expedite.

variants.text: Thank you. While you're at it, can you also check if the matching gift wrap is still available?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: If it can't make it by Friday, just cancel the whole thing.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: I appreciate the help, but I'd rather talk to a supervisor about this delay.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer received a wrong color of a backpack they ordered.

messages.content: I ordered the olive backpack but received the black one.
That's our mistake. I can send the correct one right away.
Will I need to send the black one back first?
No, you can keep it as a courtesy. The olive one ships today.

variants.text: Oh nice, thanks! Does the olive one have the same laptop sleeve compartment?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, since I'm keeping the black one anyway, can you just cancel the olive shipment and refund the difference?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: That's very generous of you. Thanks so much!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I'd rather just get a repair quote instead of dealing with the warranty process.
